text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors.

City Council on May 22 and 23, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members of Council to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors for a term starting at the Annual General Meeting in 2024 to the Annual General Meeting in 2025: Councillor Jennifer McKelvie; and Councillor Paul Ainslie.
